checkpoints.description: [1/4] Forward allowlisted app deep-link params (world dt rate reverse relativity c ke collision) from play.html into the app iframe URL; leave play-page params and unknown keys outside; shell bump v43->v44

impact_assessment.why: play.html?app=orrery&world=figure-eight drops everything except the app slug at appFrameUrl, so sitewide deep links cannot reach the sealed URL reader and the new write-back is invisible from the wrapper page
impact_assessment.benefits: Every live app's query-string knobs work through the site wrapper; archived orrery stays shareable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: appFrameUrl gains an optional third search param (existing two-arg calls unchanged); dependency: allowlist is closed so future play-page params cannot leak; concurrency: foreign catalog churn stashed until publish; state: sw.js VERSION bump invalidates the shell cache
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure helper + failing-first mjs assertions with the allowlist pinned; full live battery and deployed playwright check on ?app=orrery&world=figure-eight

impact_assessment.risks: contract: live.js gains a message listener gated on event.origin and event.source identity; dependency: mirrors reuse the site's closed DEEP_LINK_KEYS allowlist; concurrency: foreign catalog churn stashes around commits; state: sw cache version bump
